## What Changed

Closed two issues whose work converged in the single scoring line (#714).

- **#684 Signals v1 epic — CLOSED.** Backend (directionMode/scoreId passthrough, /api/signals/best, dismissal storage, holdsCfd) and frontend (card grid, confirm modal, dismiss/reveal, Screen Option) all shipped across #662/#702/#693/#687. One acceptance item (live MT5 demo fill through a card) deliberately left to a real user action per #662 — extracted to **#715**.
- **#712 Strategy-owned subscriptions — CLOSED.** `strategy_protocol` routing is the final form: the one scoring line routes every actionable per-protocol record into bot queues via subscriptions; `processSignalQueues` dispatches heads. Legacy protocolId/shortProtocolId are unused by the trading path. Multi-timeframe concern disappeared — `buildBestLadder` scores each protocol with its own bar requirements and the loop fetches no bars.
